tests.name: json_view_chain_single_escape
tests.intent: Verify parsing of a single unicode escape sequence via json_document.

tests.name: json_view_chain_double_escape
tests.intent: Verify parsing of a chain of two unicode escape sequences.

tests.name: json_view_chain_triple_escape
tests.intent: Verify parsing of a chain of three unicode escape sequences representing Japanese text.

tests.name: json_view_chain_mixed_ascii
tests.intent: Verify parsing of unicode escape chains intermixed with plain ASCII characters.

tests.name: json_view_chain_uppercase_hex
tests.intent: Verify parsing of unicode escape chains using uppercase hex letters.

tests.name: json_view_chain_surrogate_break
tests.intent: Verify that a surrogate pair inside a unicode chain falls back safely via the main loop.

tests.name: json_view_chain_bad_digit_break
tests.intent: Verify behavior when a bad hex digit appears within a unicode escape chain.

tests.name: json_view_chain_cut_bytes
tests.intent: Verify handling of string cuts that provide fewer than six bytes for a chained escape.

tests.name: json_view_chain_long_sequence
tests.intent: Verify parsing of a long chain of unicode escapes (length 20).

tests.name: json_view_chain_in_object_key
tests.intent: Verify that unicode escape chains inside object keys are decoded correctly.

tests.name: json_view_chain_lone_high_surrogate
tests.intent: Verify handling of a lone high surrogate following a valid unicode escape.

tests.name: json_view_chain_one_byte_utf8
tests.intent: Verify chains of unicode escapes that translate to single-byte ASCII characters.

tests.name: json_view_chain_two_byte_utf8
tests.intent: Verify chains of unicode escapes that translate to two-byte UTF-8 characters.

tests.name: json_view_chain_followed_by_backslash
tests.intent: Verify behavior when a unicode chain is followed by a non-\u backslash escape.

tests.name: json_view_chain_null_terminated
tests.intent: Verify parsing of json_document with explicit string length including escape chains.

tests.name: json_view_chain_empty_string
tests.intent: Verify that parsing an empty quoted string works cleanly with the builder path.

tests.name: json_view_chain_malformed_first
tests.intent: Verify that a malformed first escape properly reports an error and does not enter the chain loop.

tests.name: json_view_chain_multiple_chains
tests.intent: Verify multiple distinct chains of unicode escapes separated by plain text within one string.
